prompt: High-fidelity desktop website design comp, 16:10 landscape, for BBT Consulting, an Italian consultancy building custom operational tools integrated with existing ERP and CRM systems for SME owners and management. This must look unmistakably like a real responsive website screenshot, not a poster and not a moodboard. Visual direction: "Flusso tracciato", inspired by logistics tracking labels, production progress forms, and operational signage in bright daylight. Palette: technical off-white #F7F7F2 as dominant page ground, deep ink blue #12304A, committed cobalt #1649E0 in large fields, safety orange #FF5C21 only for high-priority markers. Crisp sans typography with an industrial editorial character, not Inter, no serif, no dark theme, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no rounded bento-card grid. Structure: slim navigation bar with BBT Consulting logo left, links "Soluzioni", "Metodo", "Chi siamo" and a clear button "Valutiamo il tuo processo" right. First viewport has an asymmetric 5/7 layout: left contains a small operational label "STRUMENTI SU MISURA PER PMI", a large Italian headline exactly "Dati dispersi e processi manuali diventano strumenti che lavorano." and a concise paragraph "Progettiamo dashboard, automazioni e applicazioni collegate ai sistemi che usi già." with primary CTA "Guarda le soluzioni realizzate" and secondary link "Come lavoriamo". Right side is a large process-tracking composition, not a generic dashboard: a visible path labeled "GESTIONALE / CRM / EXCEL" flowing through a bold cobalt BBT transformation junction toward "DATI VISIBILI / MENO ATTIVITÀ MANUALI / PROCESSI TRACCIATI"; use numbered stages, barcode-like rules, status stamps, and precise arrows. Along the lower edge of the viewport show three real proof strips: "5 flussi → 1 dashboard fatturato", "Barcode → documento CP in Arca", "87/116 requisiti NIS2 tracciati". Show a glimpse of the next section beneath the fold titled "Tre problemi reali. Tre soluzioni operative." The design should feel like a premium Italian industrial design system, direct and human, with strong whitespace and restrained precision. All text readable and correctly spelled in Italian. No invented clients, testimonials, revenue figures, percentages, or performance claims. Avoid laptop mockups, floating 3D objects, AI brains, robots, neon, black backgrounds, stock photography, decorative icon cards.
